request: Analyze GSE315575 for PMID 42268956 (A decline in skeletal muscle NOX4 abrogates exercise-induced adaptive homeostasis and exacerbates biological aging.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, unstranded, Illumina NovaSeq PE150), mouse gastrocnemius
final.sample_inclusion: 20/21-month-old male chow (4.8% fat)-fed Nox4 fl/fl (n=4) and Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl (n=4) mice; no exercise intervention in the sequenced cohort (S2.3.p4, FIG4)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of muscle-specific NOX4 deficiency on gastrocnemius gene expression in aged sedentary-housed mice (genotype effect, not an exercise effect)
planned_contrasts: Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl vs Nox4 fl/fl, aged gastrocnemius (S2.3.p4, fig. S14A; paper: 1023 DEGs = 443 up, 580 down)
final.exercise_experiments_in_paper: Treadmill training (5 wk, 3 d/wk) was done in 12-month-old mice (S4.4.3.p1, Fig. 6) and assessed by qPCR/immunoblot only; human GSE159217 (young vs old) and GSE141910 are reanalyses of other series. None of these are in GSE315575.
final.paper_results: 1023 DEGs (443 up, 580 down) KO vs control; GO/KEGG ORA of down genes (FDR<0.01); GSEA KEAP1/NFE2L2 NES -2.388, curated NFE2L2 set NES -1.88; Cybb not changed

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.12.p1 describes the only RNA-seq generated for this paper (gastrocnemius, nf-core/STAR feature counts, pydeseq2, |logFC|>0.5 and FDR<0.05). S2.3.p4 and FIG4 define the sequenced cohort as 20-21-month-old chow-fed male Nox4 fl/fl vs Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl mice, n=4 per genotype, with genotype as the only factor. Exercise training appears only in the 12-month-old cohort (S4.4.3.p1, Fig. 6), which was not sequenced. The voluntary wheel running cited for these mice (fig. S14C) is a Promethion metabolic-cage measurement, not an intervention.

checks: GEO extract_protocol: gastrocnemius from 21-month-old MckCre:Nox4 fl/fl and Nox4 fl/fl controls, matching FIG4
contact Tony Tiganis, Monash University, matches the paper's group
8 samples = 4 control + 4 KO, matching n=4 per genotype
processing (nf-core RNAseq in Laxy, STAR feature counts, polyA unstranded, Azenta NovaSeq) matches S4.12.p1

ownership.reasoning: The single supplementary counts matrix and the 8 GSMs match the paper's sequenced cohort in tissue, genotype, age, n and processing.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns ('Control 1' ... 'KO 4') sit inside the title ('Gastrocnemius, Control 1'); inspect reports 8/8 matches via title. Genotype is taken from the genotype characteristic, not from position.

matrix.reasoning: All values are integers (integer fraction 1.0, max 1.08e6, median 1), data_processing states 'raw counts matrix (STAR feature counts)', and the paper ran DESeq2 on feature counts. The matrix has 412 duplicated gene-symbol IDs, which would need collapsing or dropping before any model.

candidates.reason_rejected: A valid, analyzable genotype contrast (4 vs 4) and the paper's own estimand, but it measures NOX4 deficiency in aged sedentary-housed mice, not an exercise effect; the request asks how exercise affects gene expression.
Wheel-running distance is not in the GEO metadata, the cage measurement was not an intervention, and n=4 controls cannot support it.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in GSE315575: all 8 samples are sedentary-housed 21-month-old mice differing only by genotype (Nox4 fl/fl vs Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl). The paper's exercise-training experiment (12-month-old mice, S4.4.3.p1, Fig. 6) was not sequenced. An exercise estimand cannot be identified from these data.
design.reasoning: The only grouping column is genotype (4/4); batch, tissue, age and sex are constant. The paper's RNA-seq estimand is a genotype effect (S2.3.p4). Producing a genotype DEG list and calling it an exercise result would misstate the estimand, so the case stops at design.

discrepancies.paper: title and framing concern exercise-induced adaptive homeostasis; exercise training only in the unsequenced 12-month cohort
discrepancies.data: no exercise or activity column; genotype is the only factor
